title: Dave Rossi's fourth orb in the MH370 videos
summary: Salvatore Pais tells of Dave Rossi's fourth orb in the MH370 videos, about 2014 at Southeast Asia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Rossy's fourth orb. That's why Ashton now goes by four orbs.

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual craft designs, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that a man named Dave Rossi spotted a fourth orb in videos said to show MH370, the Malaysia Airlines passenger plane that vanished over Southeast Asia in 2014. According to Pais, that is why Ashton Forbes, who has studied these videos closely, now speaks of four orbs rather than three. If true, it would tie the plane's disappearance to glowing objects seen around it.
